stories.title: How Ukraine is disrupting Russia's Africa operations by hitting arms shipments in the Mediterranean
stories.summary: Ukrainian naval drones attacked two Russian ships in Libyan waters on Sunday. Satellite footage suggests that one vessel from Moscow's so-called ghost fleet may have docked in Benghazi and dispatched military equipment to Mali before the strikes.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
